_cronsReference.name: send-followups
_cronsReference.description: Check non-responsive leads every 7 min; send_followups itself only sends inside CONTACT_WINDOWS (08:21-20:53 CAT), so off-hours ticks are no-ops. Each lead fires at its own jittered minute for natural human send times

_cronsReference.name: send-reminders
_cronsReference.description: Customer and plumber reminders - booking, morning, 2hr, 30min alerts

_cronsReference.name: misc-jobs
_cronsReference.description: Carries every job that is not the main follow-up or reminder cron: staff-queued ScheduledFollowup dispatch over WhatsApp or email (including email follow-ups for delayed leads), IMAP inbound-email polling, job reminders, and 24h unconfirmed-lead summaries. All four are idempotent, so a 5-minute tick re-running them is safe.

_note: This file applies to EVERY service in the project and its startCommand overrides each service's own. Cron services therefore share start.sh and pick their job(s) via the PLUMBOT_CRON env var (comma-separated for several jobs per tick). The list above is documentation only - Railway does not read it.
